sequencing_rationale: Begin with atomic structure before spectra and advanced AMO control.
Build spectroscopy from atomic levels and accepted optics.
Extend atomic structure to molecules after many-particle foundations.
Develop atom-light interaction after structure, spectra and accepted quantum/optics foundations.
Cold-atom control follows local atom-light interaction; accepted C06 magnetic-field concepts remain context/reference rather than an added canonical prerequisite.
Precision measurement follows local spectroscopy and coherent control; accepted C01 metrology remains context/reference rather than an added canonical prerequisite.
